blockers.wanted: 8+ onsets for a gravel step built of dozens of stone ticks
blockers.tried: burst of 22 ticks over 0.16 s (shows 1 onset), then 22 + 16 ticks (4 onsets)
blockers.workaround: a pattern of 8 louder crunch voices 45-65 ms apart over a quiet dense tick bed, and a 0.5 s length; the onset detector merges anything under 40 ms, so the count mostly reflects how long the sound is
